mentions.name: DesignFlo
mentions.description: AI-powered platform for building enterprise-grade applications with real, scalable backends — APIs, databases, auth, and business logic. It generates production-quality Elixir backend and Svelte frontend code using opinionated algorithms and architecture, and includes a drag-and-drop visual designer, an ERD diagram editor, code export, and end-to-end hosting so users can 'vibe code' a complete production-grade app.
mentions.problem: AI models write code that is inconsistent and unreliable and never ends up being production-worthy, requiring complete rewrites; DesignFlo solves this with algorithms and opinionated architecture to consistently produce reliable code.
mentions.audience: People who want to build SaaS products and go to market faster, and those who want to architect backends themselves
